title: KCP project_access_policy_change_list result (DESIGN.md §10.1, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for project_access_policy_change_list (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of ProjectAccessPolicyChange projections (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Page of ProjectAccessPolicyChange projections; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

preparedChangeState.description: Closed prepared-change state enum, verbatim §10.1 ProjectAccessPolicyChange.state and §10.2 SpaceAccessWidening.state (§11.8: closed). A changed item set or revision makes the intent stale.

projectAccessPolicyChange.description: ProjectAccessPolicyChange projection, field names verbatim from the §10.1 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG17); Kovee pins the affected frontiers/item set and effective audience server-side (§10.1).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
